    m = re.match(r'([^:]+):(\d+):(.*)', line)

    f,ln,txt = m.group(1),int(m.group(2)),m.group(3)
    fn = re.findall(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*,?\s*(?:\(\w+\))?\s*,\s*$|,\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*,', txt)
